context_for_next_testing_agent: UBICACIÓN fallback fix is FIXED and 100% verified. Reports.jsx locOf(e,s) and reportPdf.js locOf(e,s) both prefer direccion_geolocalizada and cleanly fall back to formatted coords ('-25.31xxx, -57.55xxx') plus a MapPin link — verified 268 marked rows across 8 employees over 2 date ranges: 0 blanks. AUSENTE rows correctly still show '—'. The window.confirm('¿Eliminar las fotos...') dialog only fires now in 'share' mode (Compartir/Enviar) and does NOT fire on 'Descargar PDF' (both global and per-employee download button paths use mode='download').
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: many marks in Supabase have direccion_geolocalizada = '' (empty string) due to a race in the geocoding step at clock-in time, but they DO carry valid latitud/longitud. The old UI only rendered direccion_geolocalizada, so the Ubicación column showed '—' whenever the address string was empty even though GPS coords existed. Fix (verified): a helper locOf(e,s) is now used in both Reports.jsx (table cell + Excel export) and reportPdf.js (PDF column) which (1) picks the mark with a non-empty direccion_geolocalizada if any, else (2) picks the mark with lat/lng and formats them as 'lat.toFixed(5), lng.toFixed(5)', in both cases exposing lat/lng so the MapPin link (report-map-*) renders. Additionally ClockIn.jsx stores coords when the reverse-geocode call fails, preventing future marks from having both fields empty. Also the destructive photo-cleanup confirm dialog is now correctly gated by `if (mode === 'share' && window.confirm(...))` at Reports.jsx L218, so pressing 'Descargar PDF' never triggers it — verified by expect_download + dialog listener returning no dialogs during the download flow.
